programs.title: Bushwhacked
programs.desc: Brandon and Kayne head to Seal Rocks on the northern coast of NSW, where Brandon presents Kayne with a thrilling new mission: to swim alongside Grey Nurse Sharks and capture a photo of one. The challenge pushes Kayne out of his comfort zone, combining underwater adventure with a test of courage and skill, as he faces these gentle yet imposing predators in their natural habitat.

programs.title: Motown Magic
programs.desc: Imaginative boy Ben transforms his city by bringing colourful street art to life, armed with a magic paintbrush and the classic sounds of Motown.

programs.title: The Magic Canoe

programs.title: Spartakus And The Sun Beneath The Sea
programs.desc: In the absence of his passengers, Tehrig is captured by Ringnar, leader of the fjord brigands.

programs.title: The World According To Grandpa
programs.desc: Stanley wonders why we have names, and Grandpa tells of a time when everyone in the world was called George, and the flying Bear who changed everything.
